```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Run examples.R explicitly before rendering; rendering never fits models.
needed <- c("cache/examples.rds", "cache/hindcast_ssb.pdf",
            "tinyAM_dashboard.html")
if (!all(file.exists(needed))) {
  cli::cli_abort("Run cheatsheet/examples.R before rendering this cheatsheet.")
}
example <- readRDS("cache/examples.rds")
if (is.null(example$scores)) {
  cli::cli_abort("The example run is incomplete. Finish cheatsheet/examples.R first.")
}
revision <- system2("git", c("-C", "..", "rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE)
if (!identical(revision, example$provenance$revision)) {
  cli::cli_abort("The package revision changed. Rerun cheatsheet/examples.R first.")
}
dat <- example$dat
script <- readLines("examples.R", warn = FALSE)
excerpt <- function(name) {
  first <- match(paste0("# ---- ", name, " ----"), script)
  if (is.na(first)) cli::cli_abort("Missing example excerpt: {name}.")
  following <- grep("^# ---- .* ----$", script)
  last <- min(following[following > first]) - 1L
  code <- script[seq.int(first + 1L, last)]
  if (name == "hindcast") code <- sub("^# ", "", code[1L])
  code
}
fingerprint <- tempfile()
writeLines(unlist(lapply(c("wrangle", "inputs", "baseline", "F_mono", "rec_bh",
                           "q_mono", "N_iid"), excerpt)), fingerprint)
current_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(fingerprint))
unlink(fingerprint)
if (!identical(current_md5, example$provenance$example_md5)) {
  cli::cli_abort("The examples changed. Rerun cheatsheet/examples.R before rendering.")
}
write_code <- function(file, names) {
  code <- unlist(lapply(names, excerpt), use.names = FALSE)
  writeLines(c("\\begin{rcode}", code, "\\end{rcode}"),
             paste0("cache/code_", file, ".tex"))
}
write_code("data", c("wrangle", "inputs"))
for (name in c("baseline", "models", "dashboard", "hindcast")) {
  write_code(name, name)
}
write_code("updates_left", c("F_mono", "rec_bh"))
write_code("updates_right", c("q_mono", "N_iid"))

escape_tex <- function(x) {
  gsub("([#$%&_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
}
display <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    out <- ifelse(x == trunc(x), format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE),
                  formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "fg"))
  } else {
    out <- as.character(x)
  }
  out[is.na(x)] <- "NA"
  escape_tex(trimws(out))
}
input_table <- function(name, columns) {
  x <- dat[[name]][, columns, drop = FALSE]
  indices <- c(1L, 2L, nrow(x) - 1L, nrow(x))
  cells <- lapply(x[indices, , drop = FALSE], display)
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(4L), function(i) {
    paste(vapply(cells, function(column) column[i], character(1)), collapse = " & ")
  }, character(1))
  gap <- paste(rep("\\tablegap", length(columns)), collapse = " & ")
  header <- paste0("\\textbf{", escape_tex(columns), "}")
  header[columns %in% c("year", "age")] <- paste0(
    "\\textcolor{tamnavy}{", header[columns %in% c("year", "age")], "}")
  writeLines(c(
    paste0("\\begin{inputtable}{", paste(rep("r", length(columns)), collapse = ""), "}"),
    paste0(paste(header, collapse = " & "), " \\\\ \\hline"),
    paste0(c(rows[1:2], gap, rows[3:4]), " \\\\"),
    "\\end{inputtable}"
  ), paste0("cache/table_", name, ".tex"))
}
input_table("catch", c("year", "age", "obs"))
input_table("index", c("year", "age", "survey", "samp_time", "obs", "q_block"))
input_table("weight", c("year", "age", "obs"))
input_table("maturity", c("year", "age", "obs"))
input_table("pop_covariates", c("year", "age", "NCAM_M_assumption"))

scores <- example$scores
labels <- c(Base = "Base", F_curve = "F curve", BH = "BH",
            Mono_q = "Mono q", N_process = "N process")
score_rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(scores)), function(i) {
  x <- scores[i, ]
  label <- labels[x$model]
  if (!x$fit_converged) label <- paste0(label, "\\textsuperscript{*}")
  paste(label,
        if (is.finite(x$log_rmse)) sprintf("%.3f", x$log_rmse) else "--",
        paste0(x$n_scored_folds, "/20"),
        if (is.na(x$rank)) "--" else x$rank, sep = " & ")
}, character(1))
writeLines(c("\\begin{inputtable}{lrrr}",
             "\\textbf{Model} & \\textbf{RMSE} & \\textbf{Folds} & \\textbf{Rank} \\\\ \\hline",
             paste0(score_rows, " \\\\"), "\\end{inputtable}"),
           "cache/table_scores.tex")
if (file.info("../man/figures/logo.svg")$mtime > file.info("logo.pdf")$mtime) {
  rsvg::rsvg_pdf("../man/figures/logo.svg", "logo.pdf")
}
```

```{=latex}
\pageheader{tinyAM :: MODEL REFERENCE}{R specifications and the population assumptions they represent}
\begin{minipage}[t]{.325\linewidth}\vspace{0pt}
\begin{mathbox}{Abundance and cohort survival}
\begin{rcode}
N_settings = list(
  process = "iid", init = "exp")
\end{rcode}
\micro{$Z=F+M$; recruitment $R_t=N_{t,1}$. Age indices $1,\ldots,A$ run from the youngest modeled age to the plus group; N is start-of-year abundance.}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\widehat N_{t,a}&=N_{t-1,a-1}e^{-Z_{t-1,a-1}},\\[-1mm]
\widehat N_{t,A}&=N_{t-1,A-1}e^{-Z_{t-1,A-1}}\\[-1mm]
&\quad+N_{t-1,A}e^{-Z_{t-1,A}},\\
\log N_{t,a}&=\log\widehat N_{t,a}+\eta^N_{t,a}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\micro{For $t\ge2$, non-plus ages use the first survival equation. Initial older ages use \texttt{"exp"} survivorship, \texttt{"free"} fixed states, \texttt{"latent"} integrated states, \texttt{"mono"} decline, or \texttt{"capped"} by first recruitment.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\begin{mathbox}{Recruitment}
\begin{rcode}
rec_settings = list(process = "rw")
# Or a stock-recruit curve:
rec_settings = list(process="iid", mu_form=~bh(ssb))
\end{rcode}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{RW: }\log R_t-\log R_{t-1}&=\epsilon_t,\\
\log R_t&=\log g(SSB_{t-L})+u_t,\\
g_{BH}(S)&=\alpha S/(1+\beta S),\\
g_{Ricker}(S)&=\alpha S e^{-\beta S}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\micro{$\alpha,\beta>0$; $\epsilon_t\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_R^2)$. IID has $u_t=\epsilon_t$; AR1 has $u_t=\phi_Ru_{t-1}+\epsilon_t$ and a stationary start. Curves describe medians. Lag $L$ defaults to the youngest biological age; early boundary R is free. No RW + curve.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\begin{mathbox}{Biomass and spawning biomass}
\begin{rcode}
dat$maturity$spawn_time <- 0.25
\end{rcode}
\[
SSB_t=\sum_b n_{t,b}w_{t,b}p_{t,b}e^{-\tau_{t,b}Z_{t,b}}.
\]
\micro{Biomass is $\sum_b n_{t,b}w_{t,b}$. $b$: retained biological age; $n$: its abundance; $w$: weight; $p$: mature fraction; $\tau$: year fraction (default 0). Hidden ages retain biology/timing and share plus-age mortality.}
\end{mathbox}
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{.325\linewidth}\vspace{0pt}
\begin{mathbox}{Mean fishing mortality}
\begin{rcode}
F_settings = list(process = "iid",
  mu_form = ~ logistic(age))
\end{rcode}
\[
\begin{aligned}
S(a)&=\{1+e^{-k(a-a_{50})}\}^{-1},\quad k>0,\\
\log F_{t,a}&=\beta_F+\log S(a)+\eta^F_{t,a}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\micro{\texttt{mu\_form = \string~ mono(age)} instead adds cumulative nonnegative log-mean steps. Both curves require IID/AR1; annual F can depart from the rising mean.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\begin{mathbox}{Natural mortality}
\begin{rcode}
M_settings = list(process = "iid",
  mu_supplied = ~ M0)
\end{rcode}
\[
\log M_{t,a}=\log M^0_{t,a}+\eta^M_{t,a}.
\]
\micro{\texttt{M0} comes from \texttt{pop\_covariates}. M states share age blocks and start in year 2 by default; other cells retain the mean. \texttt{"off"} fixes M to its mean; \texttt{mu\_form} adds log-mean effects.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\begin{mathbox}{Variation in N, F and M}
\begin{rcode}
F_settings = list(process = "cor_rw",
  sd_form = ~ factor(age))
\end{rcode}
\micro{Ordinary age-based SD formulas give $\sigma_a=\exp(X_a\beta_\sigma)$. N, F and M have separate parameters; shared SDs do not share states.}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{IID: }&\eta_{t,a}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_a^2),\\
\text{RW: }&\eta_{t,a}-\eta_{t-1,a}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_a^2).
\end{aligned}
\]
\micro{AR1 stationary covariance (state/block distances):}
\[
\operatorname{Cov}(\eta_{t,a},\eta_{s,b})=
\frac{\sigma_a\sigma_b\phi_t^{|t-s|}\phi_a^{|a-b|}}
{(1-\phi_t^2)(1-\phi_a^2)}.
\]
\micro{F \texttt{"cor\_rw"}: independent annual increment vectors with}
\[
\Sigma_{ab}=\sigma_a\sigma_b\rho^{|a-b|},\quad-1<\rho<1.
\]
\micro{RW starts are unpenalized. N/M \texttt{"off"} gives $\eta=0$.}
\end{mathbox}
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{.325\linewidth}\vspace{0pt}
\begin{mathbox}{Survey catchability}
\begin{rcode}
index_settings = list(
  q_form = ~ mono(q_block), q_link = "log")
\end{rcode}
\[
\eta_{q,k}=\beta_q+\sum_{j<k}d_j,\quad d_j\ge0,
\qquad q_k=e^{\eta_{q,k}}.
\]
\micro{Zero steps give exact plateaus; \texttt{\string~ q\_block} leaves age patterns unrestricted. With \texttt{q\_link = "logit"}:}
\[
q_k=\{1+e^{-\eta_{q,k}}\}^{-1}.
\]
\micro{\texttt{\string~ logistic(age)} multiplies inverse-link q by $S(a)$. \texttt{iid()}, \texttt{rw()} and \texttt{ar1()} can add Gaussian variation. q covariates come from \texttt{index}.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\begin{mathbox}{Catch and survey observations}
\begin{rcode}
catch_settings = list(sd_form = ~ 1)
index_settings = list(sd_form = ~ survey)
\end{rcode}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\widetilde C_{t,a}&=N_{t,a}\frac{F_{t,a}}{Z_{t,a}}(1-e^{-Z_{t,a}}),\\
\widetilde I_i&=q_iN_{t_i,a_i}e^{-s_iZ_{t_i,a_i}},\\
\log Y_i&\sim\mathcal N(\log\widetilde Y_i,\sigma_i^2),\\
\sigma_i&=\sigma_i^0\exp(X_{sd,i}\beta_{sd}).
\end{aligned}
\]
\micro{$s_i$: survey sampling fraction. $\sigma_i^0=1$ unless a baseline SD is provided. Gaussian formula effects can also modify log SD. Predictions are medians; zero/NA observations are excluded, with complete predictions.}
\end{mathbox}\vspace{2mm}
\smallkey{Check fit, uncertainty and predictive skill}\par\vspace{1mm}
\begin{rcode}
check_tam(fit)
hind <- fit_hindcast(fit, folds = 20)
hind$hindcast_rmse
\end{rcode}
\micro{The joint likelihood includes active process, formula-effect and observation densities. RTMB integrates random effects by Laplace approximation; intervals use local curvature. Standardized residuals $(\log Y_i-\log\widetilde Y_i)/\sigma_i$ depend on fitted, shrunken states. Convergence does not establish identifiability. Hindcasts return log RMSE and retrospective Mohn's $\rho$.}
\end{minipage}
\pagefooter{Equation details: \texttt{?\string"tinyAM-model\string"}, \texttt{?recruitment\_formulas}, \texttt{?catchability\_curves} · github.com/PaulRegular/tinyAM}

```
